news.headline: Chargers QB Justin Herbert's finger injury not considered major
news.summary: Herbert fractured a finger on his non-throwing hand diving to make a tackle after a Week 4 interception, played through it with a glove, and isn't considered at risk for Week 5.

news.headline: Bengals WR Tee Higgins (adductor) day-to-day, could play Week 5
news.summary: Higgins is considered day-to-day with an adductor strain suffered late in Sunday's loss at Jacksonville and has not been ruled out for Sunday's game at Miami.

news.headline: Rams QB Matthew Stafford dealing hip injury
news.summary: Stafford is managing a hip contusion from the Week 4 loss to Philadelphia but is expected to be close to full-go for Week 5 against Buffalo.

news.headline: Isaiah Likely follows John Harbaugh to the Giants on a $40M deal
news.summary: Likely signed with the Giants in March 2026 after Harbaugh left Baltimore to become New York's head coach, which confirms the long-flagged 'Isaiah Likely, NYG' roster entry is correct, not a stale screenshot error.

news.headline: Eagles Place RB Tank Bigsby On IR; Saquon Barkley Likely to Miss Week 5
news.summary: Bigsby underwent core-muscle surgery and landed on injured reserve, with a timeline that could keep him out into November.

news.headline: Bhayshul Tuten Firmly Establishing Himself as Jaguars' Lead Back
news.summary: Tuten has pulled away as Jacksonville's clear lead back in snaps and touches, with Chris Rodriguez Jr. a complementary piece rather than a real threat to the job.

news.headline: Jaguars' Parker Washington: Draws double-digit targets
news.summary: Washington led all Jacksonville receivers in targets and played a season-high 71% of snaps in Week 4, a clear sign his role is trending up.

news.headline: George Pickens Looking for a Contract Extension
news.summary: Pickens is eligible for a new deal after 2026 and just posted his best game as a Cowboy (8-134-2) against Baltimore, adding leverage to that conversation.

news.headline: Browns place RB Dylan Sampson (knee) on injured reserve
news.summary: Sampson, who was earmarked for third-down work behind Quinshon Judkins, landed on IR with a knee injury, pushing Raheim Sanders into the backup role.

news.headline: Bengals Depth Chart Preview: Running back room follows Chase Brown's indisputable lead
news.summary: Perine remains Cincinnati's clear RB2 behind Chase Brown, a non-threatening change-of-pace piece with no standalone value while Brown is healthy.

news.headline: Brandon Aubrey misses Cowboys practice — because of jury duty
news.summary: Aubrey missed a Wednesday practice after being selected for jury duty on a felony trial in Tarrant County, but it carries no injury risk for Thursday's game.

Tempting as that pattern looks, don't chase last week's points by benching your clearly better asset — that exact overcorrection sat live in your Week 4 lineup for five straight days (Shough over Herbert) until this run flagged it again.

Left the QB slot completely empty all week (Shough would've scored 15.94 sitting there unused) and started Josh Downs (4.6) over Omarion Hampton (13.3) in the flex — an 8.7-point unforced error stacked on a totally wasted roster slot. A win over a weak opponent papered over the worst bench-management week of the season so far; double-check every single slot is filled before Thursday lock, every week, no exceptions.
